name: jqml
description: Syntax highlighting, completions and diagnostics for the JQML engine

jqml.enginePath.description: Optional path to a JQML v3 engine root. Leave empty to use the types bundled in the extension.

jqml.configPath.description: Path to a JQML compiler JSON config with dirs/includes. Absolute path, ${workspaceFolder}, and ${env:NAME} are supported. Placeholders inside the config are taken from jqml.env and the process environment.

jqml.env.description: Environment variables used when resolving ${NAME} placeholders in jqml.configPath and in the compiler config. These values override the process environment.

jqml.hideInternalMembers.description: Hide engine-internal members such as JQ* and AX/AY from completions.
